description: Read the default integrator fee of a Trnch partner. Returns { partner, bps, maxBps }: partner is the partner code, bps the default fee in basis points (0 to maxBps, 100). The default fee is added to the Trnch fee on swaps attributed to the partner and paid to the partner through the partner program; integratorFeeBps on a quote, buy or sell overrides it for that request; the default applies only to requests that carry X-Trnch-Partner-Key. Authentication: header X-Trnch-Partner-Key linked to a Trnch partner, or Authorization: Bearer <API key> of the partner payout wallet; 401 otherwise. 20 calls per minute per IP (429).
name: trnch_partner_fee_get
title: Read the partner integrator fee
